request.text: Those who lived tore the Eye out, and the dragon went blind. So they broke it in twelve, and sent each shard to a people at the far ends of the world. Never settle, never shine, everything carried. He made me copy it every morning. Take me with you. I can carry books, and I can read them. Say it again, slower. I want to write it right.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Female, 20-25. Excellent quality. Persona: a scholar's apprentice who grew up among old books and has never left the library. Emotion: earnest, curious, precise, quietly warm. A clear, bright, articulate voice with light, careful diction; quick when something excites her, soft and steady when she reads aloud.
